An '''anti-virus''' or '''anti-viral'''<ref name="GFT">''[[Galladinium's Fantastic Technology]]''</ref> was a cure for a contagion, usually working though a small exposure to the contagion in question along with some curative compounds. They could be delivered in pill form or injections.
